scope: Posthoc comparison of five frozen libraries and 24 planned student runs. Method sets and Jaccards reproduce the partial pre-test audit's semantic granularity, not exhaustive claims of absence. Visual estimates are automated, not human labels.

canonical_semantic_vocabulary.camera_projection: Project world landmarks into camera image coordinates and report depth.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.landmark_residual: Calculate a numerical discrepancy between projected and target landmarks.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.camera_aim: Aim a camera at a target with optional lens setting.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.hinge_transform: Apply or diagnose a declared hinge-based pose; implementations and parenting assumptions differ.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.hinge_edge_candidates: Calculate candidate free-edge positions from a hinge, width and angles, without posing an assembly.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.sampled_vertical_support: Sample downward rays to screen vertical support gaps; not a contact proof.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.aabb_support_screen: Screen vertical and horizontal support relationships using axis-aligned bounds.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.aabb_separation: Measure or classify separation using axis-aligned bounding boxes.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.world_aabb: Expose world-space axis-aligned bounds as a standalone method.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.scene_graph_relations: Report parent relationships or components, not physical connectivity.
canonical_semantic_vocabulary.directional_noise_material: Construct a mapped directional procedural noise material. Coordinate systems and parameters differ.

libraries.source_policy: Teacher prior and common development inputs; no historical trajectories or complete GT.
libraries.provenance_note: Prior and common inputs are permitted sources, not proof of the precise intellectual origin of each method.

libraries.source_policy: Six strategy-guided development trajectories plus common inputs; no complete GT.
libraries.provenance_note: Research report links diagnostics to historical checks and trials, but exact original guidance wording was unavailable; no independent transfer established. The SKILL generation-workspace path differs from the mounted path; effect on behavior is unknown.

libraries.source_policy: Six exploration-guided development trajectories plus common inputs; no complete GT.
libraries.provenance_note: The report describes historical comparisons and selections, not proven transfer. Hinge candidates compute positions, not assembly transformations. An attempted historical contact sheet failed because Pillow was unavailable.

libraries.source_policy: Three complete development GT scenes and common inputs; no historical student trajectories.
libraries.provenance_note: Reported direct GT queries contextualize methods alongside general geometry and shader knowledge; stored GT observations are not student outcomes. Synthetic tests do not establish image improvement. Validation observed displacement of parented components, so pivot preservation is not proof of a coherent assembly.

libraries.source_policy: The same three complete development GT scenes as A4 plus the same six exploration trajectories as A3.
libraries.provenance_note: Reported GT and exploration evidence motivated units but do not establish unique causal origin or transfer. An initial learning projection assertion failed before later units were reached; a corrected rerun and separate synthetic validation are recorded in the audit.

semantic_jaccard.definition: Intersection size divided by union size of the listed method-label sets; the audit counts A3's standalone world_aabb but does not separately count bounds used as subroutines in other libraries. This asymmetric exposure rule and semantic granularity affect results.

complementary_and_redundant_cases.case: All five include camera projection and directional noise material; shared labels do not imply identical implementation, use, or outcome.
A2 and A5 share six of seven audited labels, but A2 alone includes camera aim in these sets and common labels do not establish common provenance.
A3 computes hinge-edge candidates while A4 applies a declared hinge transform; these differ in operation and can be complementary rather than interchangeable.
A4 uses broad-phase AABB support screening and parent-graph components; A5 samples vertical support rays and reports AABB separation. Neither approach proves physical support or connectivity.

student_outcomes.fields: Rows are [run, complete_delivery, model_visual_estimate_0_100, auxiliary_ssim]; human_rating is null for every row. Missing visual scores are null, not zero.
student_outcomes.delivery_summary: 22 of 24 delivered all three artifacts. A2 delivered 2/4; each other condition delivered 4/4. Both missing A2 runs had zero recorded Blender executions; SDK completion is not delivery.
student_outcomes.reproduction: All 22 delivered runs were recorded as source-only portable and pixel-identical on regeneration. This is reproducibility, not reconstruction quality.

prespecified_task_contrasts.interpretation: Within-scene arithmetic first condition minus second; no imputation, significance claim, or isolated causal tool-versus-text interpretation.

exposure_and_adoption.initial_context: Audits report verbatim SKILL text and explicit capabilities mount notice for all A1-A5 sessions, not A0; Bash and Write tool definitions were present in all 24 serialized inputs.
exposure_and_adoption.interpretation: Initial text exposure is distinct from later file reading, import, reached callable invocation, and explicitly attributed reimplementation. Compact run annotations often find no later documented helper use; this does not rule out cognitive influence. Generic procedural similarity alone is not transfer evidence: A-T03-A0 also constructed a mapped procedural noise floor without a library.

unsupported_claims: The observed results establish a general visual improvement from GT, exploration, a library, or executable tools over text.
A missing A2 delivery implies zero visual quality or was caused by the library path discrepancy.
Initial SKILL exposure proves a helper was called, or absence of a documented call proves no influence.
An AABB overlap, sampled near-zero gap, parent link, or attractive image proves physical contact, collision-free articulation, or structural correctness.
A synthetic unit probe or historical candidate selection validates independent-scene transfer.
Historical door candidate G was retained, or a relocated hinge was independently verified as a coherent structural repair.
A semantic label match proves copied code, common method provenance, or equal implementation behavior.
limitations: Four matched scenes, one student sample per scene and condition, and one frozen library per condition do not support population-level conclusions or isolate library content from condition-specific effects.
Visual judgments are automated and all human ratings are null; SSIM is auxiliary and can disagree in direction with model visual estimates.
Two A2 visual outcomes are missing. Complete-case contrasts have only two observed pairs and cannot represent missing scenes.
The pre-test method inventory is partial and depends on the audit's label granularity and standalone-exposure rule; unlisted methods are not necessarily absent.
Development research reports describe source access, observations and proposed motivations; direct raw GT query outputs and historical trajectories were not independently rechecked here.
Single-image scale, hidden geometry, materials and illumination are not uniquely identifiable. Projected bounding boxes and proposed correspondences are not validated segmentation masks.
There is no content-matched text-versus-tools ablation. Source-only regeneration and synthetic tests are not quality or causal validations.
Projection mapping eligibility was reviewed in separate bounded per-scene sessions and was not independently repeated here.
